dAgency.01.name: EMS Agency Unique State ID
dAgency.01.definition: The unique ID assigned to the EMS Agency which is associated with all state licensure numbers and information.

dAgency.02.name: EMS Agency Number
dAgency.02.definition: The state-assigned provider number of the responding agency.

dAgency.03.name: EMS Agency Name
dAgency.03.definition: The formal name of the agency.

dAgency.04.name: EMS Agency State
dAgency.04.definition: The state/territory which assigned the EMS agency number.

dAgency.05.name: EMS Agency Service Area States
dAgency.05.definition: The states in which the EMS Agency provides services including the state associated with the EMS Agency Number.

dAgency.06.name: EMS Agency Service Area County(ies)
dAgency.06.definition: The county(ies) within each state for which the agency formally provides service.

dAgency.07.name: EMS Agency Census Tracts
dAgency.07.definition: The US census tracts in which the EMS agency formally provides service.

dAgency.08.name: EMS Agency Service Area ZIP Codes
dAgency.08.definition: The ZIP codes for the EMS Agency's service area.

dAgency.09.name: Primary Type of Service
dAgency.09.definition: The primary service type provided by the agency.

dAgency.10.name: Other Types of Service
dAgency.10.definition: The other service type(s) which are provided by the agency.

dAgency.11.name: Level of Service
dAgency.11.definition: The level of service which the agency provides EMS care for every request for service (the minimum certification level). This may be the license level granted by the state EMS office.

dAgency.12.name: Organization Status
dAgency.12.definition: The primary organizational status of the agency. The definition of Volunteer or Non-Volunteer is based on state or local definitions.

dAgency.13.name: Organizational Type
dAgency.13.definition: The organizational structure from which EMS services are delivered (fire, hospital, county, etc).

dAgency.14.name: EMS Agency Organizational Tax Status
dAgency.14.definition: The EMS Agencies business/corporate organizational tax status.

dAgency.15.name: Statistical Calendar Year
dAgency.15.definition: The calendar year to which the information pertains for the EMS Agency and the specific EMS Agency Number (dAgency.02).

dAgency.16.name: Total Primary Service Area Size
dAgency.16.definition: The total square miles in the agency's service area.

dAgency.17.name: Total Service Area Population
dAgency.17.definition: The total population in the agency's service area based if possible on year 2010 census data.

dAgency.18.name: 911 EMS Call Center Volume per Year
dAgency.18.definition: The number of 911 calls received by the call center during the last calendar year.

dAgency.19.name: EMS Dispatch Volume per Year
dAgency.19.definition: The number of EMS dispatches during the last calendar year.

dAgency.20.name: EMS Patient Transport Volume per Year
dAgency.20.definition: The number of EMS transports per year based on last calendar year.

dAgency.21.name: EMS Patient Contact Volume per Year
dAgency.21.definition: The number of EMS patient contacts per year based on last calendar year.

dAgency.22.name: EMS Billable Calls per Year
dAgency.22.definition: The number of EMS patient encounters which are billable based on the last calendar year.

dAgency.23.name: EMS Agency Time Zone
dAgency.23.definition: The time zone for the EMS Agency.

dAgency.24.name: EMS Agency Daylight Savings Time Use
dAgency.24.definition: Indicate if the EMS Agency conforms to Daylight Savings Time.

dAgency.25.name: National Provider Identifier
dAgency.25.definition: The National Provider Identifier issued by CMS.

dAgency.26.name: Fire Department ID Number
dAgency.26.definition: The state assigned Fire Department ID Number for EMS Agency(ies) operating within a Fire Department.

eAirway.01.name: Indications for Invasive Airway
eAirway.01.definition: The clinical indication for performing invasive airway management.

eAirway.02.name: Date/Time Airway Device Placement Confirmation
eAirway.02.definition: The date and time the airway device placement was confirmed.

eAirway.03.name: Airway Device Being Confirmed
eAirway.03.definition: The airway device in which placement is being confirmed.

eAirway.04.name: Airway Device Placement Confirmed Method
eAirway.04.definition: The method used to confirm the airway device placement.

eAirway.05.name: Tube Depth
eAirway.05.definition: The measurement at the patient's teeth/lip of the tube depth in centimeters (cm) of the invasive airway placed.

eAirway.06.name: Type of Individual Confirming Airway Device Placement
eAirway.06.definition: The type of individual who confirmed the airway device placement.

eAirway.07.name: Crew Member ID
eAirway.07.definition: The statewide assigned ID number of the EMS crew member confirming the airway placement.

eAirway.08.name: Airway Complications Encountered
eAirway.08.definition: The airway management complications encountered during the patient care episode.

eAirway.09.name: Suspected Reasons for Failed Airway Management
eAirway.09.definition: The reason(s) the airway was unable to be successfully managed.

eAirway.10.name: Date/Time Decision to Manage the Patient with an Invasive Airway
eAirway.10.definition: The date and time the decision was made to manage the patient's airway with an invasive airway device.

eAirway.11.name: Date/Time Invasive Airway Placement Attempts Abandoned
eAirway.11.definition: The date and time that the invasive airway attempts were abandoned for the patient.

eArrest.01.name: Cardiac Arrest
eArrest.01.definition: Indication of the presence of a cardiac arrest at any time during this EMS event.

eArrest.02.name: Cardiac Arrest Etiology
eArrest.02.definition: Indication of the etiology or cause of the cardiac arrest (classified as cardiac, non-cardiac, etc.).

eArrest.03.name: Resuscitation Attempted By EMS
eArrest.03.definition: Indication of an attempt to resuscitate the patient who is in cardiac arrest (attempted, not attempted due to DNR, etc.).

eArrest.04.name: Arrest Witnessed By
eArrest.04.definition: Indication of who the cardiac arrest was witnessed by.

eArrest.07.name: AED Use Prior to EMS Arrival
eArrest.07.definition: Documentation of AED use Prior to EMS Arrival.

eArrest.09.name: Type of CPR Provided
eArrest.09.definition: Documentation of the type/technique of CPR used by EMS.

eArrest.10.name: Therapeutic Hypothermia by EMS
eArrest.10.definition: Documentation of EMS initiation of Therapeutic Hypothermia.

eArrest.11.name: First Monitored Arrest Rhythm of the Patient
eArrest.11.definition: Documentation of what the first monitored arrest rhythm which was noted.

eArrest.12.name: Any Return of Spontaneous Circulation
eArrest.12.definition: Indication whether or not there was any return of spontaneous circulation.

eArrest.13.name: Neurological Outcome at Hospital Discharge
eArrest.13.definition: The level of cerebral performance of the patient at the time of discharge from the Hospital.

eArrest.14.name: Date/Time of Cardiac Arrest
eArrest.14.definition: The date/time of the cardiac arrest (if not known, please estimate).

eArrest.16.name: Reason CPR/Resuscitation Discontinued
eArrest.16.definition: The reason that CPR or the resuscitation efforts were discontinued.

eArrest.17.name: Cardiac Rhythm on Arrival at Destination
eArrest.17.definition: The patient's cardiac rhythm upon delivery or transfer to the destination.

eArrest.18.name: End of EMS Cardiac Arrest Event
eArrest.18.definition: The patient's outcome at the end of the EMS event.

eArrest.19.name: Date/Time of Initial CPR
eArrest.19.definition: The initial date and time that CPR was started by anyone.

eArrest.20.name: Who First Initiated CPR
eArrest.20.definition: Who first initiated CPR for this EMS event.

eArrest.21.name: Who First Applied the AED
eArrest.21.definition: Documentation of who first applied the AED for this EMS event.

eArrest.22.name: Who First Defibrillated the Patient
eArrest.22.definition: Documentation of who first defibrillated the patient.

eCrew.01.name: Crew Member ID
eCrew.01.definition: The state certification/licensure ID number assigned to the crew member.

eCrew.02.name: Crew Member Level
eCrew.02.definition: The functioning level of the crew member ID during this EMS patient encounter.

eCrew.03.name: Crew Member Response Role
eCrew.03.definition: The role(s) of the crew member during response, at scene treatment, and/or transport.

eCustomConfiguration.01.name: Custom Data Element Title
eCustomConfiguration.01.definition: This is the title of the custom data element created to collect information that is not defined formally in NEMSIS Version 3.

eCustomConfiguration.02.name: Custom Definition
eCustomConfiguration.02.definition: The definition of the custom element and how it should be used.

eCustomConfiguration.03.name: Custom Data Type
eCustomConfiguration.03.definition: The data type of the custom element.

eCustomConfiguration.04.name: Custom Data Element Recurrence
eCustomConfiguration.04.definition: Indication if the data element will accept multiple values.

eCustomConfiguration.05.name: Custom Data Element Usage
eCustomConfiguration.05.definition: The Usage (Mandatory, Required, Recommended or Optional) for the Custom Data Element.

eCustomConfiguration.06.name: Custom Data Element Potential Values
eCustomConfiguration.06.definition: The values which are associated with the Custom Data Element. Values would be the choices provided to the user when they document the Custom Data Element.

eCustomConfiguration.07.name: Custom Data Element Potential NOT Values (NV)
eCustomConfiguration.07.definition: NOT Values (NV) associated with the custom element.

eCustomConfiguration.08.name: Custom Data Element Potential Pertinent Negative Values (PN)
eCustomConfiguration.08.definition: Pertinent Negative Values (PN) associated with the custom element.

eCustomResults.01.name: Custom Data Element Result
eCustomResults.01.definition: The actual value or values chosen (if values listed in eCustomConfiguration.06) or result (free text, Date/Time, or number) documented for the Custom Data Element.

eCustomResults.02.name: Custom Element ID Referenced
eCustomResults.02.definition: References the CustomElementID attribute for eCustomConfiguration.CustomGroup.

eCustomResults.03.name: CorrelationID of PatientCareReport Element or Group
eCustomResults.03.definition: References the CorrelationID attribute of an element or group in the PatientCareReport section.

eDevice.01.name: Medical Device Serial Number
eDevice.01.definition: The unique manufacturer's serial number associated with a medical device.

eDevice.02.name: Date/Time of Event (per Medical Device)
eDevice.02.definition: The time of the event recorded by the device's internal clock.

eDevice.03.name: Medical Device Event Type
eDevice.03.definition: The type of event documented by the medical device.

eDevice.04.name: Medical Device Waveform Graphic Type
eDevice.04.definition: The description of the waveform file stored in Waveform Graphic (eDevice.05).

eDevice.06.name: Medical Device Mode (Manual, AED, Pacing, CO2, O2, etc)
eDevice.06.definition: The mode of operation the device is operating in during the defibrillation, pacing, or rhythm analysis by the device (if appropriate for the event).

eDevice.07.name: Medical Device ECG Lead
eDevice.07.definition: The lead or source which the medical device used to obtain the rhythm (if appropriate for the event).

eDevice.08.name: Medical Device ECG Interpretation
eDevice.08.definition: The interpretation of the rhythm by the device (if appropriate for the event).

eDevice.09.name: Type of Shock
eDevice.09.definition: The type of shock used by the device for the defibrillation (if appropriate for the event).

eDevice.10.name: Shock or Pacing Energy
eDevice.10.definition: The energy (in joules) used for the shock or pacing (if appropriate for the event).

eDevice.11.name: Total Number of Shocks Delivered
eDevice.11.definition: The number of times the patient was defibrillated, if the patient was defibrillated during the patient encounter.

eDevice.12.name: Pacing Rate
eDevice.12.definition: The rate the device was calibrated to pace during the event, if appropriate.

eDispatch.01.name: Dispatch Reason
eDispatch.01.definition: The dispatch reason reported to the responding unit.

eDispatch.02.name: EMD Performed
eDispatch.02.definition: Indication of whether Emergency Medical Dispatch was performed for this EMS event.

eDispatch.03.name: EMD Card Number
eDispatch.03.definition: The EMD card number reported by dispatch, consisting of the card number, dispatch level, and dispatch mode.

eDispatch.04.name: Dispatch Center Name or ID
eDispatch.04.definition: The name or ID of the dispatch center providing electronic data to the PCR for the EMS agency, if applicable.

eDispatch.05.name: Dispatch Priority (Patient Acuity)
eDispatch.05.definition: The actual, apparent, or potential acuity of the patient's condition as determined through information obtained during the EMD process.

eDispatch.06.name: Unit Dispatched CAD Record ID
eDispatch.06.definition: The unique ID assigned by the CAD system for the specific unit response.

eDisposition.01.name: Destination/Transferred To, Name
eDisposition.01.definition: The destination the patient was delivered or transferred to.

eDisposition.02.name: Destination/Transferred To, Code
eDisposition.02.definition: The code of the destination the patient was delivered or transferred to.

eDisposition.03.name: Destination Street Address
eDisposition.03.definition: The street address of the destination the patient was delivered or transferred to.

eDisposition.04.name: Destination City
eDisposition.04.definition: The city of the destination the patient was delivered or transferred to (physical address).

eDisposition.05.name: Destination State
eDisposition.05.definition: The state of the destination the patient was delivered or transferred to.

eDisposition.06.name: Destination County
eDisposition.06.definition: The destination county in which the patient was delivered or transferred to.

eDisposition.07.name: Destination ZIP Code
eDisposition.07.definition: The destination ZIP code in which the patient was delivered or transferred to.

eDisposition.09.name: Destination GPS Location
eDisposition.09.definition: The destination GPS Coordinates to which the patient was delivered or transferred to.

eDisposition.10.name: Destination Location US National Grid Coordinates
eDisposition.10.definition: The US National Grid Coordinates for the Destination Location. This may be the Healthcare Facility US National Grid Coordinates.

eDisposition.11.name: Number of Patients Transported in this EMS Unit
eDisposition.11.definition: The number of patients transported by this EMS crew and unit.

eDisposition.13.name: How Patient Was Moved to Ambulance
eDisposition.13.definition: The method by which the patient was moved to the ambulance from the scene.

eDisposition.14.name: Position of Patient During Transport
eDisposition.14.definition: The position of the patient during transport from the scene.

eDisposition.15.name: How Patient Was Moved From Ambulance
eDisposition.15.definition: The method by which the patient was moved from the ambulance to the destination.

eDisposition.16.name: EMS Transport Method
eDisposition.16.definition: The method of transport by this EMS Unit.

eDisposition.17.name: Transport Mode from Scene
eDisposition.17.definition: Indication whether the transport was emergent or non-emergent.

eDisposition.18.name: Additional Transport Mode Descriptors
eDisposition.18.definition: The documentation of transport mode techniques for this EMS response.

eDisposition.19.name: Final Patient Acuity
eDisposition.19.definition: The acuity of the patient's condition after EMS care.

eDisposition.20.name: Reason for Choosing Destination
eDisposition.20.definition: The reason the unit chose to deliver or transfer the patient to the destination.

eDisposition.21.name: Type of Destination
eDisposition.21.definition: The type of destination the patient was delivered or transferred to.

eDisposition.22.name: Hospital In-Patient Destination
eDisposition.22.definition: The location within the hospital that the patient was taken directly by EMS (e.g., Cath Lab, ICU, etc.).

eDisposition.23.name: Hospital Capability
eDisposition.23.definition: The primary hospital capability associated with the patient's condition for this transport (e.g., Trauma, STEMI, Peds, etc.).

eDisposition.24.name: Destination Team Pre-Arrival Alert or Activation
eDisposition.24.definition: Indication that an alert (or activation) was called by EMS to the appropriate destination healthcare facility team. The alert (or activation) should occur prior to the EMS Unit arrival at the destination with the patient.

eDisposition.25.name: Date/Time of Destination Prearrival Alert or Activation
eDisposition.25.definition: The Date/Time EMS alerted, notified, or activated the Destination Healthcare Facility prior to EMS arrival. The EMS assessment identified the patient as acutely ill or injured based on exam and possibly specified alert criteria.

eDisposition.26.name: Disposition Instructions Provided
eDisposition.26.definition: Information provided to patient during disposition for patients not transported or treated.

eDisposition.27.name: Unit Disposition
eDisposition.27.definition: The patient disposition for an EMS event identifying whether patient contact was made.

eDisposition.28.name: Patient Evaluation/Care
eDisposition.28.definition: The patient disposition for an EMS event identifying whether a patient was evaluated and care or services were provided.

eDisposition.29.name: Crew Disposition
eDisposition.29.definition: The crew disposition for this EMS event identifying which crew provided primary patient care or whether support services were required.

eDisposition.30.name: Transport Disposition
eDisposition.30.definition: The transport disposition for an EMS event identifying whether a transport occurred and by which unit.

eDisposition.31.name: Reason for Refusal/Release
eDisposition.31.definition: Describes reason(s) for the patient's refusal of care/transport OR the EMS clinician's decision to release the patient.

eDisposition.32.name: Level of Care Provided per Protocol
eDisposition.32.definition: The general level of care provided to this patient as defined per provider level in local EMS protocols or clinical guidelines.

eExam.01.name: Estimated Body Weight in Kilograms
eExam.01.definition: The patient's body weight in kilograms either measured or estimated.

eExam.02.name: Length Based Tape Measure
eExam.02.definition: The length-based color as taken from the tape.

eExam.04.name: Skin Assessment
eExam.04.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's skin.

eExam.05.name: Head Assessment
eExam.05.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's head.

eExam.06.name: Face Assessment
eExam.06.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's face.

eExam.07.name: Neck Assessment
eExam.07.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's neck.

eExam.09.name: Heart Assessment
eExam.09.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's heart.

eExam.10.name: Abdominal Assessment Finding Location
eExam.10.definition: The location of the patient's abdomen assessment findings.

eExam.11.name: Abdomen Assessment
eExam.11.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's abdomen.

eExam.12.name: Pelvis/Genitourinary Assessment
eExam.12.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's pelvis/genitourinary.

eExam.13.name: Back and Spine Assessment Finding Location
eExam.13.definition: The location of the patient's back and spine assessment findings.

eExam.14.name: Back and Spine Assessment
eExam.14.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's spine (Cervical, Thoracic, Lumbar, and Sacral) and back exam.

eExam.15.name: Extremity Assessment Finding Location
eExam.15.definition: The location of the patient's extremity assessment findings.

eExam.16.name: Extremities Assessment
eExam.16.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's extremities.

eExam.17.name: Eye Assessment Finding Location
eExam.17.definition: The location of the patient's eye assessment findings.

eExam.18.name: Eye Assessment
eExam.18.definition: The assessment findings of the patient's eye examination.

eExam.19.name: Mental Status Assessment
eExam.19.definition: The assessment findings of the patient's mental status examination.

eExam.20.name: Neurological Assessment
eExam.20.definition: The assessment findings of the patient's neurological examination.

eExam.21.name: Stroke/CVA Symptoms Resolved
eExam.21.definition: Indication if the Stroke/CVA Symptoms resolved and when.

eExam.22.name: Lung Assessment Finding Location
eExam.22.definition: The location of the patient's lung assessment findings.

eExam.23.name: Lung Assessment
eExam.23.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's lungs.

eExam.24.name: Chest Assessment Finding Location
eExam.24.definition: The location of the patient's chest assessment findings.

eExam.25.name: Chest Assessment
eExam.25.definition: The assessment findings associated with the patient's chest.

eHistory.01.name: Barriers to Patient Care
eHistory.01.definition: Indication of whether or not there were any patient specific barriers to serving the patient at the scene.

eHistory.02.name: Last Name of Patient's Practitioner
eHistory.02.definition: The last name of the patient's practitioner.

eHistory.03.name: First Name of Patient's Practitioner
eHistory.03.definition: The first name of the patient's practitioner.

eHistory.04.name: Middle Name/Initial of Patient's Practitioner
eHistory.04.definition: The middle name or initial of the patient's practitioner.

eHistory.05.name: Advance Directives
eHistory.05.definition: The presence of a valid DNR form, living will, or document directing end of life or healthcare treatment decisions.

eHistory.07.name: Environmental/Food Allergies
eHistory.07.definition: The patient's known allergies to food or environmental agents.

eHistory.08.name: Medical/Surgical History
eHistory.08.definition: The patient's pre-existing medical and surgery history of the patient.

eHistory.09.name: Medical History Obtained From
eHistory.09.definition: Type of person medical history obtained from.

eHistory.10.name: The Patient's Type of Immunization
eHistory.10.definition: The immunization type of the patient.

eHistory.11.name: Immunization Year
eHistory.11.definition: The year associated with each immunization type.

eHistory.12.name: Current Medications
eHistory.12.definition: The medications the patient currently takes.

eHistory.13.name: Current Medication Dose
eHistory.13.definition: The numeric dose or amount of the patient's current medication.

eHistory.14.name: Current Medication Dosage Unit
eHistory.14.definition: The dosage unit of the patient's current medication.

eHistory.15.name: Current Medication Administration Route
eHistory.15.definition: The administration route (po, SQ, etc.) of the patient's current medication.

eHistory.16.name: Presence of Emergency Information Form
eHistory.16.definition: Indication of the presence of the Emergency Information Form associated with patient's with special healthcare needs.

eHistory.17.name: Alcohol/Drug Use Indicators
eHistory.17.definition: Indicators for the potential use of alcohol or drugs by the patient related to the patient's current illness or injury.

eHistory.18.name: Pregnancy
eHistory.18.definition: Indication of the possibility by the patient's history of current pregnancy.

eHistory.19.name: Last Oral Intake
eHistory.19.definition: Date and Time of last oral intake.

eHistory.20.name: Current Medication Frequency
eHistory.20.definition: The frequency of administration of the patient's current medication.

eInjury.01.name: Cause of Injury
eInjury.01.definition: The category of the reported/suspected external cause of the injury.

eInjury.02.name: Mechanism of Injury
eInjury.02.definition: The mechanism of the event which caused the injury.

eInjury.03.name: Trauma Triage Criteria (High Risk for Serious Injury)
eInjury.03.definition: Trauma triage criteria for the red boxes (Injury Patterns and Mental Status and Vital Signs) in the 2021 ACS National Guideline for the Field Triage of Injured Patients.

eInjury.04.name: Trauma Triage Criteria (Moderate Risk for Serious Injury)
eInjury.04.definition: Trauma triage criteria for the yellow boxes (Mechanism of Injury and EMS Judgment) in the 2021 ACS National Guideline for the Field Triage of Injured Patients.

eInjury.05.name: Main Area of the Vehicle Impacted by the Collision
eInjury.05.definition: The area or location of initial impact on the vehicle based on 12-point clock diagram.

eInjury.06.name: Location of Patient in Vehicle
eInjury.06.definition: The seat row location of the vehicle at the time of the crash with the front seat numbered as 1.

eInjury.07.name: Use of Occupant Safety Equipment
eInjury.07.definition: Safety equipment in use by the patient at the time of the injury.

eInjury.09.name: Height of Fall (feet)
eInjury.09.definition: The distance in feet the patient fell, measured from the lowest point of the patient to the ground.

eInjury.10.name: OSHA Personal Protective Equipment Used
eInjury.10.definition: Documentation of the use of OSHA required protective equipment used by the patient at the time of injury.

eInjury.11.name: ACN System/Company Providing ACN Data
eInjury.11.definition: The agency providing the Automated Collision Notification (ACN) Data.

eInjury.12.name: ACN Incident ID
eInjury.12.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Incident ID.

eInjury.13.name: ACN Call Back Phone Number
eInjury.13.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Call Back Phone Number (US Only).

eInjury.14.name: Date/Time of ACN Incident
eInjury.14.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Incident Date and Time.

eInjury.15.name: ACN Incident Location
eInjury.15.definition: The Automated Collision Notification GPS Location.

eInjury.16.name: ACN Incident Vehicle Body Type
eInjury.16.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Vehicle Body Type.

eInjury.17.name: ACN Incident Vehicle Manufacturer
eInjury.17.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Vehicle Manufacturer (e.g., General Motors, Ford, BMW, etc.).

eInjury.18.name: ACN Incident Vehicle Make
eInjury.18.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Vehicle Make (e.g., Cadillac, Ford, BMW, etc.).

eInjury.19.name: ACN Incident Vehicle Model
eInjury.19.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Vehicle Model (e.g., Escalade, Taurus, X6M, etc.).

eInjury.20.name: ACN Incident Vehicle Model Year
eInjury.20.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Vehicle Model Year (e.g., 2010).

eInjury.21.name: ACN Incident Multiple Impacts
eInjury.21.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Indication of Multiple Impacts associated with the collision.

eInjury.22.name: ACN Incident Delta Velocity
eInjury.22.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Delta Velocity (Delta V) force associated with the crash.

eInjury.23.name: ACN High Probability of Injury
eInjury.23.definition: The Automated Collision Notification of the High Probability of Injury.

eInjury.24.name: ACN Incident PDOF
eInjury.24.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Principal Direction of Force (PDOF).

eInjury.25.name: ACN Incident Rollover
eInjury.25.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Indication that the Vehicle Rolled Over.

eInjury.26.name: ACN Vehicle Seat Location
eInjury.26.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Indication of the Occupant(s) Seat Location(s) within the vehicle.

eInjury.27.name: Seat Occupied
eInjury.27.definition: Indication if seat is occupied based on seat sensor data.

eInjury.28.name: ACN Incident Seatbelt Use
eInjury.28.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Indication of Seatbelt use by the occupant(s).

eInjury.29.name: ACN Incident Airbag Deployed
eInjury.29.definition: The Automated Collision Notification Indication of Airbag Deployment.

eLabs.01.name: Date/Time of Laboratory or Imaging Result
eLabs.01.definition: The data and time for the specific laboratory result.

eLabs.02.name: Study/Result Prior to this Unit's EMS Care
eLabs.02.definition: Indicates that the laboratory result occurred prior to this EMS units care.

eLabs.03.name: Laboratory Result Type
eLabs.03.definition: The type of the laboratory value.

eLabs.04.name: Laboratory Result
eLabs.04.definition: The value or result of the laboratory test (Units may vary).

eLabs.05.name: Imaging Study Type
eLabs.05.definition: The type of x-ray or imaging study.

eLabs.06.name: Imaging Study Results
eLabs.06.definition: The description or interpretation of the results of the imaging study.

eLabs.07.name: Imaging Study File or Waveform Graphic Type
eLabs.07.definition: The description of the image study file or waveform graphic stored in Imaging Study File or Waveform Graphic (eLabs.08).

eLabs.08.name: Imaging Study File or Waveform Graphic

eMedications.01.name: Date/Time Medication Administered
eMedications.01.definition: The date/time medication administered to the patient.

eMedications.02.name: Medication Administered Prior to this Unit's EMS Care
eMedications.02.definition: Indicates that the medication administration which is documented was administered prior to this EMS units care.

eMedications.03.name: Medication Administered
eMedications.03.definition: The medication administered to the patient.

eMedications.04.name: Medication Administered Route
eMedications.04.definition: The route medication was administered to the patient.

eMedications.05.name: Medication Dosage
eMedications.05.definition: The dose or amount of the medication administered to the patient.

eMedications.06.name: Medication Dosage Units
eMedications.06.definition: The unit of medication dosage administered to patient.

eMedications.07.name: Response to Medication
eMedications.07.definition: The patient's response to the medication.

eMedications.08.name: Medication Complication
eMedications.08.definition: Any complication (abnormal effect on the patient) associated with the administration of the medication to the patient by EMS.

eMedications.09.name: Medication Crew (Healthcare Professionals) ID
eMedications.09.definition: The statewide assigned ID number of the EMS crew member giving the treatment to the patient.

eMedications.10.name: Role/Type of Person Administering Medication
eMedications.10.definition: The type (level) of EMS or Healthcare Professional Administering the Medication. For medications administered prior to EMS arrival, this may be a non-EMS healthcare professional.

eMedications.11.name: Medication Authorization
eMedications.11.definition: The type of treatment authorization obtained.

eMedications.12.name: Medication Authorizing Physician
eMedications.12.definition: The name of the authorizing physician ordering the medication administration if the order was provided by any manner other than protocol (standing order) in eMedications.11.

eNarrative.01.name: Patient Care Report Narrative
eNarrative.01.definition: The narrative of the patient care report (PCR).

eOther.01.name: Review Requested
eOther.01.definition: Indication of whether the PCR needs review by anyone.

eOther.02.name: Potential System of Care/Specialty/Registry Patient
eOther.02.definition: An indication if the patient may meet the entry criteria for an injury or illness specific registry.

eOther.03.name: Personal Protective Equipment Used
eOther.03.definition: The personal protective equipment which was used by EMS personnel during this EMS patient contact.

eOther.04.name: EMS Professional (Crew Member) ID
eOther.04.definition: The ID number of the EMS Crew Member associated with eOther.03, eOther.05, eOther.06.

eOther.05.name: Suspected EMS Work Related Exposure, Injury, or Death
eOther.05.definition: Indication of an EMS work related exposure, injury, or death associated with this EMS event.

eOther.06.name: The Type of Work-Related Injury, Death or Suspected Exposure
eOther.06.definition: The type of EMS crew member work-related injury, death, or suspected exposure related to the EMS response.

eOther.07.name: Natural, Suspected, Intentional, or Unintentional Disaster
eOther.07.definition: Event caused by natural forces or Suspected and Intentional/Unintentional Disasters (terrorism).

eOther.08.name: Crew Member Completing this Report
eOther.08.definition: The statewide assigned ID number of the EMS crew member which completed this patient care report.

eOther.09.name: External Electronic Document Type
eOther.09.definition: Document type which has been electronically stored with PCR.

eOther.10.name: File Attachment Type
eOther.10.definition: The description of the file attachment stored in File Attachment Image (eOther.11).

eOther.11.name: File Attachment Image
eOther.11.definition: The file that is attached electronically to the patient care report.

eOther.12.name: Type of Person Signing
eOther.12.definition: The individual's signature associated with eOther.15 (Signature Status).

eOther.13.name: Signature Reason
eOther.13.definition: The reason for the individuals signature.

eOther.14.name: Type Of Patient Representative
eOther.14.definition: If Patient Representative is chosen as the owner of the signature, this documents the relationship of the individual signing to the patient.

eOther.15.name: Signature Status
eOther.15.definition: Indication that the signature for the Type of Person Signing and Signature Reason has been collected or attempted to be collected.

eOther.16.name: Signature File Name
eOther.16.definition: The name of the graphic file for the signature.

eOther.17.name: Signature File Type
eOther.17.definition: The description of the file attachment stored in Signature Graphic (eOther.18).

eOther.18.name: Signature Graphic
eOther.18.definition: The graphic file for the signature.

eOther.19.name: Date/Time of Signature
eOther.19.definition: The date and time the signature was captured.

eOther.20.name: Signature Last Name
eOther.20.definition: The last name of the individual who signed the associated signature.

eOther.21.name: Signature First Name
eOther.21.definition: The first name of the individual associated with the signature.

eOther.22.name: File Attachment Name
eOther.22.definition: The name of the attached file.

eOutcome.01.name: Emergency Department Disposition
eOutcome.01.definition: The known disposition of the patient from the Emergency Department (ED).

eOutcome.02.name: Hospital Disposition
eOutcome.02.definition: The known disposition of the patient from the hospital, if admitted.

eOutcome.03.name: External Report ID/Number Type
eOutcome.03.definition: The Type of External Report or Record associated with the Report/ID Number.

eOutcome.04.name: External Report ID/Number
eOutcome.04.definition: The ID or Number of the external report or record in eOutcome.03.

eOutcome.05.name: Other Report Registry Type
eOutcome.05.definition: The type of external report/registry that was documented as "other" in eOutcome.03

eOutcome.09.name: Emergency Department Procedures
eOutcome.09.definition: The procedures performed on the patient during the emergency department visit.

eOutcome.10.name: Emergency Department Diagnosis
eOutcome.10.definition: The practitioner's description of the condition or problem for which Emergency Department services were provided.

eOutcome.11.name: Date/Time of Hospital Admission
eOutcome.11.definition: The date and time the patient was admitted to the hospital.

eOutcome.12.name: Hospital Procedures
eOutcome.12.definition: Hospital Procedures performed on the patient during the hospital admission.

eOutcome.13.name: Hospital Diagnosis
eOutcome.13.definition: The hospital diagnosis of the patient associated with the hospital admission.

eOutcome.16.name: Date/Time of Hospital Discharge
eOutcome.16.definition: The date the patient was discharged from the hospital.

eOutcome.18.name: Date/Time of Emergency Department Admission
eOutcome.18.definition: The date and time the patient was admitted to the emergency department.

eOutcome.19.name: Date/Time Emergency Department Procedure Performed
eOutcome.19.definition: The date/time the emergency department procedure was performed on the patient.

eOutcome.20.name: Date/Time Hospital Procedure Performed
eOutcome.20.definition: The date/time the hospital procedure was performed on the patient.

ePatient.01.name: EMS Patient ID
ePatient.01.definition: The unique ID for the patient within the Agency.

ePatient.04.name: Middle Initial/Name
ePatient.04.definition: The patient's middle name, if any.

ePatient.06.name: Patient's Home City
ePatient.06.definition: The patient's primary city or township of residence.

ePatient.07.name: Patient's Home County
ePatient.07.definition: The patient's home county or parish of residence.

ePatient.08.name: Patient's Home State
ePatient.08.definition: The state, territory, or province where the patient resides.

ePatient.09.name: Patient's Home ZIP Code
ePatient.09.definition: The patient's ZIP code of residence.

ePatient.10.name: Patient's Country of Residence
ePatient.10.definition: The country of residence of the patient.

ePatient.11.name: Patient Home Census Tract
ePatient.11.definition: The census tract in which the patient lives.

ePatient.14.name: Race
ePatient.14.definition: The patient's race as defined by the OMB (US Office of Management and Budget).

ePatient.15.name: Age
ePatient.15.definition: The patient's age (either calculated from date of birth or best approximation).

ePatient.16.name: Age Units
ePatient.16.definition: The unit used to define the patient's age.

ePatient.19.name: Patient's Email Address
ePatient.19.definition: The email address of the patient.

ePatient.20.name: State Issuing Driver's License
ePatient.20.definition: The state that issued the drivers license.

ePatient.22.name: Alternate Home Residence
ePatient.22.definition: Documentation of the type of patient without a home ZIP/Postal Code.

ePayment.01.name: Primary Method of Payment
ePayment.01.definition: The primary method of payment or type of insurance associated with this EMS encounter.

ePayment.02.name: Physician Certification Statement
ePayment.02.definition: Indication of whether a physician certification statement (PCS) is available documenting the medical necessity or the EMS encounter.

ePayment.03.name: Date Physician Certification Statement Signed
ePayment.03.definition: The date the Physician Certification Statement was signed.

ePayment.04.name: Reason for Physician Certification Statement
ePayment.04.definition: The reason for EMS transport noted on the Physician Certification Statement.

ePayment.05.name: Healthcare Provider Type Signing Physician Certification Statement
ePayment.05.definition: The type of healthcare provider who signed the Physician Certification Statement.

ePayment.06.name: Last Name of Individual Signing Physician Certification Statement
ePayment.06.definition: The last name of the healthcare provider who signed the Physician Certification Statement.

ePayment.07.name: First Name of Individual Signing Physician Certification Statement
ePayment.07.definition: The first name of the healthcare provider who signed the Physician Certification Statement.

ePayment.08.name: Patient Resides in Service Area
ePayment.08.definition: An indication of whether the patient's current residence is within the EMS agency service area.

ePayment.09.name: Insurance Company ID
ePayment.09.definition: The ID Number of the patient's insurance company.

ePayment.10.name: Insurance Company Name
ePayment.10.definition: The name of the patient's insurance company.

ePayment.11.name: Insurance Company Billing Priority
ePayment.11.definition: The billing priority or order for the insurance company.

ePayment.12.name: Insurance Company Address
ePayment.12.definition: The mailing address of the Insurance Company.

ePayment.13.name: Insurance Company City
ePayment.13.definition: The insurance company's city or township used for mailing purposes.

ePayment.14.name: Insurance Company State
ePayment.14.definition: The insurance company's state, territory, or province, or District of Columbia.

ePayment.17.name: Insurance Group ID
ePayment.17.definition: The ID number of the patient's insurance group.

ePayment.18.name: Insurance Policy ID Number
ePayment.18.definition: The ID number of the patient's insurance policy.

ePayment.19.name: Last Name of the Insured
ePayment.19.definition: The last (family) name of the person insured by the insurance company.

ePayment.20.name: First Name of the Insured
ePayment.20.definition: The first (given) name of the person insured by the insurance company.

ePayment.21.name: Middle Initial/Name of the Insured
ePayment.21.definition: The middle name, if any, of the person insured by the insurance company.

ePayment.22.name: Relationship to the Insured
ePayment.22.definition: The relationship of the patient to the primary insured person.

ePayment.23.name: Closest Relative/Guardian Last Name
ePayment.23.definition: The last (family) name of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

ePayment.24.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian First Name
ePayment.24.definition: The first (given) name of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

ePayment.25.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian Middle Initial/Name
ePayment.25.definition: The middle name/initial, if any, of the closest patient's relative or guardian.

ePayment.26.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian Street Address
ePayment.26.definition: The street address of the residence of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

ePayment.27.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian City
ePayment.27.definition: The primary city or township of residence of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

ePayment.28.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian State
ePayment.28.definition: The state of residence of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

ePayment.29.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian ZIP Code
ePayment.29.definition: The ZIP Code of the residence of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

ePayment.30.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian Country
ePayment.30.definition: The country of residence of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

ePayment.31.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian Phone Number
ePayment.31.definition: The phone number of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

ePayment.32.name: Closest Relative/ Guardian Relationship
ePayment.32.definition: The relationship of the patient's closest relative or guardian.

ePayment.34.name: Patient's Employer's Address
ePayment.34.definition: The street address of the patient's employer.

ePayment.35.name: Patient's Employer's City
ePayment.35.definition: The city or township of the patient's employer used for mailing purposes.

ePayment.36.name: Patient's Employer's State
ePayment.36.definition: The state of the patient's employer.

ePayment.37.name: Patient's Employer's ZIP Code
ePayment.37.definition: The ZIP Code of the patient's employer.

ePayment.38.name: Patient's Employer's Country
ePayment.38.definition: The country of the patient's employer.

ePayment.40.name: Response Urgency
ePayment.40.definition: The urgency in which the EMS agency began to mobilize resources for this EMS encounter.

ePayment.41.name: Patient Transport Assessment
ePayment.41.definition: Documentation of the patient's transport need based on mobility and/or physical capability.

ePayment.42.name: Specialty Care Transport Care Provider
ePayment.42.definition: Documentation to show the patient care provided to the patient met the Specialty Care Transport Base Rate requirements.

ePayment.44.name: Ambulance Transport Reason Code
ePayment.44.definition: The CMS Ambulance Transport Reason Code for the transport.

ePayment.45.name: Round Trip Purpose Description
ePayment.45.definition: Free text description providing the purpose of the round trip EMS transport based on CR109 field for CMS.

ePayment.46.name: Stretcher Purpose Description
ePayment.46.definition: Free Text Documentation providing the reason for use of a stretcher in the EMS patient transport.

ePayment.47.name: Ambulance Conditions Indicator
ePayment.47.definition: Documentation of the CRC03 through CRC07 requirements for CMS billing using X12 transactions.

ePayment.48.name: Mileage to Closest Hospital Facility
ePayment.48.definition: The mileage to the closest hospital facility from the scene. Documented only if the patient was transported to a facility farther away than the closest hospital.

ePayment.49.name: ALS Assessment Performed and Warranted
ePayment.49.definition: Documentation that the patient required an ALS assessment and it was performed.

ePayment.50.name: CMS Service Level
ePayment.50.definition: The CMS service level for this EMS encounter.

ePayment.51.name: EMS Condition Code
ePayment.51.definition: The condition code associated with the CMS EMS negotiated rule-making process.

ePayment.52.name: CMS Transportation Indicator
ePayment.52.definition: The CMS Ambulance Fee Schedule Transportation and Air Medical Transportation Indicators are used to better describe why it was necessary for the patient to be transported in a particular way or circumstance.

ePayment.53.name: Transport Authorization Code
ePayment.53.definition: Prior authorization code provided by the insurance carrier/payer.

ePayment.54.name: Prior Authorization Code Payer
ePayment.54.definition: The Payer who has provided the Prior Authorization Code.

ePayment.55.name: Supply Item Used Name
ePayment.55.definition: The name of the supply used on the patient by the EMS Crew during the EMS event.

ePayment.56.name: Number of Supply Item(s) Used
ePayment.56.definition: The number of the specific supply item used on the patient by the EMS Crew during the EMS event.

ePayment.57.name: Payer Type
ePayment.57.definition: Payer type according to X12 standard.

ePayment.58.name: Insurance Group Name
ePayment.58.definition: The name of the patient's insurance group.

ePayment.59.name: Insurance Company Phone Number
ePayment.59.definition: The phone number for the patient's insurance company.

ePayment.60.name: Date of Birth of the Insured
ePayment.60.definition: The date of birth of the person insured by the insurance company.

eProcedures.01.name: Date/Time Procedure Performed
eProcedures.01.definition: The date/time the procedure was performed on the patient.

eProcedures.02.name: Procedure Performed Prior to this Unit's EMS Care
eProcedures.02.definition: Indicates that the procedure which was performed and documented was performed prior to this EMS units care.

eProcedures.03.name: Procedure
eProcedures.03.definition: The procedure performed on the patient.

eProcedures.04.name: Size of Procedure Equipment
eProcedures.04.definition: The size of the equipment used in the procedure on the patient.

eProcedures.05.name: Number of Procedure Attempts
eProcedures.05.definition: The number of attempts taken to complete a procedure or intervention regardless of success.

eProcedures.06.name: Procedure Successful
eProcedures.06.definition: Indicates that this individual procedure attempt which was performed on the patient was successful.

eProcedures.07.name: Procedure Complication
eProcedures.07.definition: Any complication (abnormal effect on the patient) associated with the performance of the procedure on the patient.

eProcedures.08.name: Response to Procedure
eProcedures.08.definition: The patient's response to the procedure.

eProcedures.09.name: Procedure Crew Members ID
eProcedures.09.definition: The statewide assigned ID number of the EMS crew member performing the procedure on the patient.

eProcedures.10.name: Role/Type of Person Performing the Procedure
eProcedures.10.definition: The type (level) of EMS or Healthcare Professional performing the procedure. For procedures performed prior to EMS arrival, this may be a non-EMS healthcare professional.

eProcedures.11.name: Procedure Authorization
eProcedures.11.definition: The type of treatment authorization obtained.

eProcedures.12.name: Procedure Authorizing Physician
eProcedures.12.definition: The name of the authorizing physician ordering the procedure, if the order was provided by any manner other than protocol (standing order) in eProcedures.11.

eProcedures.13.name: Vascular Access Location
eProcedures.13.definition: The location of the vascular access site attempt on the patient, if applicable.

eProtocols.01.name: Protocols Used
eProtocols.01.definition: The protocol used by EMS personnel to direct the clinical care of the patient.

eProtocols.02.name: Protocol Age Category
eProtocols.02.definition: The age group the protocol is written to address.

eRecord.01.name: Patient Care Report Number
eRecord.01.definition: The unique number automatically assigned by the EMS agency for each Patient Care Report (PCR). This should be a unique number for the EMS agency for all of time.

eRecord.02.name: Software Creator
eRecord.02.definition: The name of the vendor, manufacturer, and developer who designed the application that created this record.

eRecord.03.name: Software Name
eRecord.03.definition: The name of the application used to create this record.

eRecord.04.name: Software Version
eRecord.04.definition: The version of the application used to create this record.

eResponse.01.name: EMS Agency Number
eResponse.01.definition: The state-assigned provider number of the responding agency.

eResponse.03.name: Incident Number
eResponse.03.definition: The incident number assigned by the 911 Dispatch System.

eResponse.04.name: EMS Response Number
eResponse.04.definition: The internal EMS response number which is unique for each EMS Vehicle's (Unit) response to an incident within an EMS Agency.

eResponse.05.name: Type of Service Requested
eResponse.05.definition: The type of service or category of service requested of the EMS Agency responding for this specific EMS event.

eResponse.06.name: Standby Purpose
eResponse.06.definition: The main reason the EMS Unit is on Standby as the Primary Type of Service for the EMS event.

eResponse.07.name: Unit Transport and Equipment Capability
eResponse.07.definition: The transport and equipment capabilities of the EMS Unit which responded to this specific EMS event.

eResponse.08.name: Type of Dispatch Delay
eResponse.08.definition: The dispatch delays, if any, associated with the dispatch of the EMS unit to the EMS event.

eResponse.09.name: Type of Response Delay
eResponse.09.definition: The response delays, if any, of the EMS unit associated with the EMS event.

eResponse.10.name: Type of Scene Delay
eResponse.10.definition: The scene delays, if any, of the EMS unit associated with the EMS event.

eResponse.11.name: Type of Transport Delay
eResponse.11.definition: The transport delays, if any, of the EMS unit associated with the EMS event.

eResponse.12.name: Type of Turn-Around Delay
eResponse.12.definition: The turn-around delays, if any, of EMS unit associated with the EMS event.

eResponse.13.name: EMS Vehicle (Unit) Number
eResponse.13.definition: The unique physical vehicle number of the responding unit.

eResponse.14.name: EMS Unit Call Sign
eResponse.14.definition: The EMS unit number used to dispatch and communicate with the unit. This may be the same as the EMS Unit/Vehicle Number in many agencies.

eResponse.16.name: Vehicle Dispatch Location
eResponse.16.definition: The geographic location of the EMS unit or crew at the time of dispatch.

eResponse.17.name: Vehicle Dispatch GPS Location
eResponse.17.definition: The GPS coordinates associated with the EMS unit at the time of dispatch documented in decimal degrees.

eResponse.18.name: Vehicle Dispatch Location US National Grid Coordinates
eResponse.18.definition: The US National Grid Coordinates for the EMS Vehicle's Dispatch Location.

eResponse.19.name: Beginning Odometer Reading of Responding Vehicle
eResponse.19.definition: The mileage (counter or odometer reading) of the vehicle at the beginning of the call (when the wheels begin moving). If EMS vehicle/unit is via water or air travel document the number in "hours" as it relates to the documentation of Boat, Fixed Wing, or Rotor Craft in eDisposition.16 (EMS Transport Method).

eResponse.20.name: On-Scene Odometer Reading of Responding Vehicle
eResponse.20.definition: The mileage (counter or odometer reading) of the vehicle when it arrives at the scene. If EMS vehicle/unit is via water or air travel document the number in "hours" as it relates to the documentation of Boat, Fixed Wing, or Rotor Craft in eDisposition.16 (EMS Transport Method).

eResponse.21.name: Patient Destination Odometer Reading of Responding Vehicle
eResponse.21.definition: The mileage (counter or odometer reading) of the vehicle when it arrives at the patient's destination. If EMS vehicle/unit is via water or air travel document the number in "hours" as it relates to the documentation of Boat, Fixed Wing, or Rotor Craft in eDisposition.16 (EMS Transport Method).

eResponse.22.name: Ending Odometer Reading of Responding Vehicle
eResponse.22.definition: If using a counter, this is the mileage traveled beginning with dispatch through the transport of the patient to their destination and ending when back in service, starting from 0. If EMS vehicle/unit is via water or air travel document the number in "hours" as it relates to the documentation of boat, Fixed Wing, or Rotor Craft in eDisposition.16.

eResponse.23.name: Response Mode to Scene
eResponse.23.definition: The indication whether the response was emergent or non-emergent. An emergent response is an immediate response.

eResponse.24.name: Additional Response Mode Descriptors
eResponse.24.definition: The documentation of response mode techniques used for this EMS response.

eScene.01.name: First EMS Unit on Scene
eScene.01.definition: Documentation that this EMS Unit was the first EMS Unit among all EMS Agencies on the Scene.

eScene.02.name: Other EMS or Public Safety Agencies at Scene
eScene.02.definition: Other EMS agency names that were at the scene, if any.

eScene.03.name: Other EMS or Public Safety Agency ID Number
eScene.03.definition: The ID number for the EMS Agency or Other Public Safety listed in eScene.02.

eScene.04.name: Type of Other Service at Scene
eScene.04.definition: The type of public safety or EMS service associated with Other Agencies on Scene.

eScene.05.name: Date/Time Initial Responder Arrived on Scene
eScene.05.definition: The time that the initial responder arrived on the scene, if applicable.

eScene.06.name: Number of Patients at Scene
eScene.06.definition: Indicator of how many total patients were at the scene.

eScene.07.name: Mass Casualty Incident
eScene.07.definition: Indicator if this event would be considered a mass casualty incident (overwhelmed existing EMS resources).

eScene.08.name: Triage Classification for MCI Patient
eScene.08.definition: The color associated with the initial triage assessment/classification of the MCI patient.

eScene.09.name: Incident Location Type
eScene.09.definition: The kind of location where the incident happened.

eScene.10.name: Incident Facility Code
eScene.10.definition: The state, regulatory, or other unique number (code) associated with the facility if the Incident is a Healthcare Facility.

eScene.11.name: Scene GPS Location
eScene.11.definition: The GPS coordinates associated with the Scene.

eScene.12.name: Scene US National Grid Coordinates
eScene.12.definition: The US National Grid Coordinates for the Scene.

eScene.13.name: Incident Facility or Location Name
eScene.13.definition: The name of the facility, business, building, etc. associated with the scene of the EMS event.

eScene.14.name: Mile Post or Major Roadway
eScene.14.definition: The mile post or major roadway associated with the incident locations.

eScene.15.name: Incident Street Address
eScene.15.definition: The street address where the patient was found, or, if no patient, the address to which the unit responded.

eScene.16.name: Incident Apartment, Suite, or Room
eScene.16.definition: The number of the specific apartment, suite, or room where the incident occurred.

eScene.17.name: Incident City
eScene.17.definition: The city or township (if applicable) where the patient was found or to which the unit responded (or best approximation).

eScene.18.name: Incident State
eScene.18.definition: The state, territory, or province where the patient was found or to which the unit responded (or best approximation).

eScene.19.name: Incident ZIP Code
eScene.19.definition: The ZIP code of the incident location.

eScene.20.name: Scene Cross Street or Directions
eScene.20.definition: The nearest cross street to the incident address or directions from a recognized landmark or the second street name of an intersection.

eScene.21.name: Incident County
eScene.21.definition: The county or parish where the patient was found or to which the unit responded (or best approximation).

eScene.22.name: Incident Country
eScene.22.definition: The country of the incident location.

eScene.23.name: Incident Census Tract
eScene.23.definition: The census tract in which the incident occurred.

eScene.24.name: First Other EMS or Public Safety Agency at Scene to Provide Patient Care
eScene.24.definition: When there are multiple other EMS Agencies or Public Safety Agencies at the scene, this element documents the other EMS or public safety agency that was first to provide care to the patient.

eSituation.01.name: Date/Time of Symptom Onset
eSituation.01.definition: The date and time the symptom began (or was discovered) as it relates to this EMS event. This is described or estimated by the patient, family, and/or healthcare professionals.

eSituation.02.name: Possible Injury
eSituation.02.definition: Indication whether or not there was an injury.

eSituation.03.name: Complaint Type
eSituation.03.definition: The type of patient healthcare complaint being documented.

eSituation.04.name: Complaint
eSituation.04.definition: The statement of the problem by the patient or the history provider.

eSituation.06.name: Time Units of Duration of Complaint
eSituation.06.definition: The time units of the duration of the patient's complaint.

eSituation.07.name: Chief Complaint Anatomic Location
eSituation.07.definition: The primary anatomic location of the chief complaint as identified by EMS personnel.

eSituation.08.name: Chief Complaint Organ System
eSituation.08.definition: The primary organ system of the patient injured or medically affected.

eSituation.09.name: Primary Symptom
eSituation.09.definition: The primary sign and symptom present in the patient or observed by EMS personnel.

eSituation.10.name: Other Associated Symptoms
eSituation.10.definition: Other symptoms identified by the patient or observed by EMS personnel.

eSituation.11.name: Provider's Primary Impression
eSituation.11.definition: The EMS personnel's impression of the patient's primary problem or most significant condition which led to the management given to the patient (treatments, medications, or procedures).

eSituation.12.name: Provider's Secondary Impressions
eSituation.12.definition: The EMS personnel's impression of the patient's secondary problem or most significant condition which led to the management given to the patient (treatments, medications, or procedures).

eSituation.13.name: Initial Patient Acuity
eSituation.13.definition: The acuity of the patient's condition upon EMS arrival at the scene.

eSituation.14.name: Work-Related Illness/Injury
eSituation.14.definition: Indication of whether or not the illness or injury is work related.

eSituation.15.name: Patient's Occupational Industry
eSituation.15.definition: The occupational industry of the patient's work.

eSituation.17.name: Patient Activity
eSituation.17.definition: The activity the patient was involved in at the time the patient experienced the onset of symptoms or experienced an injury.

eSituation.18.name: Date/Time Last Known Well
eSituation.18.definition: The estimated date and time the patient was last known to be well or in their usual state of health. This is described or estimated by the patient, family, and/or bystanders.

eSituation.19.name: Justification for Transfer or Encounter
eSituation.19.definition: The ordering physician or medical provider diagnosis or stated reason for a hospital-to-hospital transfer, other medical transport, or Mobile Integrated Healthcare encounter.

eSituation.20.name: Reason for Interfacility Transfer/Medical Transport
eSituation.20.definition: The general categories of the reason for an interfacility transfer/medical transport.

eTimes.01.name: PSAP Call Date/Time
eTimes.01.definition: The date/time the phone rings (911 call to public safety answering point or other designated entity) requesting EMS services.

eTimes.02.name: Dispatch Notified Date/Time
eTimes.02.definition: The date/time dispatch was notified by the 911 call taker (if a separate entity).

eTimes.03.name: Unit Notified by Dispatch Date/Time
eTimes.03.definition: The date/time the responding unit was notified by dispatch.

eTimes.04.name: Dispatch Acknowledged Date/Time
eTimes.04.definition: The date/time the dispatch was acknowledged by the EMS Unit.

eTimes.05.name: Unit En Route Date/Time
eTimes.05.definition: The date/time the unit responded; that is, the time the vehicle started moving.

eTimes.06.name: Unit Arrived on Scene Date/Time
eTimes.06.definition: The date/time the responding unit arrived on the scene; that is, the time the vehicle stopped moving at the scene.

eTimes.07.name: Arrived at Patient Date/Time
eTimes.07.definition: The date/time the responding unit arrived at the patient's side.

eTimes.08.name: Transfer of EMS Patient Care Date/Time
eTimes.08.definition: The date/time the patient was transferred from this EMS agency to another EMS agency for care.

eTimes.09.name: Unit Left Scene Date/Time
eTimes.09.definition: The date/time the responding unit left the scene (started moving).

eTimes.10.name: Arrival at Destination Landing Area Date/Time
eTimes.10.definition: The date/time the Air Medical vehicle arrived at the destination landing area.

eTimes.11.name: Patient Arrived at Destination Date/Time
eTimes.11.definition: The date/time the responding unit arrived with the patient at the destination or transfer point.

eTimes.12.name: Destination Patient Transfer of Care Date/Time
eTimes.12.definition: The date/time that patient care was transferred to the destination healthcare staff.

eTimes.13.name: Unit Back in Service Date/Time
eTimes.13.definition: The date/time the unit back was back in service and available for response (finished with call, but not necessarily back in home location).

eTimes.14.name: Unit Canceled Date/Time
eTimes.14.definition: The date/time the unit was canceled.

eTimes.15.name: Unit Back at Home Location Date/Time
eTimes.15.definition: The date/time the responding unit was back in their service area. With agencies who utilized Agency Status Management, home location means the service area as assigned through the agency status management protocol.

eTimes.16.name: EMS Call Completed Date/Time
eTimes.16.definition: The date/time the responding unit completed all tasks associated with the event including transfer of the patient, and such things as cleaning and restocking.

eTimes.17.name: Unit Arrived at Staging Area Date/Time
eTimes.17.definition: The date/time the responding unit arrived at a staging area, prior to arrival on scene.

eVitals.01.name: Date/Time Vital Signs Taken
eVitals.01.definition: The date/time vital signs were taken on the patient.

eVitals.02.name: Obtained Prior to this Unit's EMS Care
eVitals.02.definition: Indicates that the information which is documented was obtained prior to the documenting EMS units care.

eVitals.03.name: Cardiac Rhythm / Electrocardiography (ECG)
eVitals.03.definition: The cardiac rhythm / ECG and other electrocardiography findings of the patient as interpreted by EMS personnel.

eVitals.04.name: ECG Type
eVitals.04.definition: The type of ECG associated with the cardiac rhythm.

eVitals.08.name: Method of Blood Pressure Measurement
eVitals.08.definition: Indication of method of blood pressure measurement.

eVitals.10.name: Heart Rate
eVitals.10.definition: The patient's heart rate expressed as a number per minute.

eVitals.11.name: Method of Heart Rate Measurement
eVitals.11.definition: The method in which the Heart Rate was measured. Values include auscultated, palpated, electronic monitor.

eVitals.13.name: Pulse Rhythm
eVitals.13.definition: The clinical rhythm of the patient's pulse.

eVitals.14.name: Respiratory Rate
eVitals.14.definition: The patient's respiratory rate expressed as a number per minute.

eVitals.16.name: End Tidal Carbon Dioxide (ETCO2)
eVitals.16.definition: The numeric value of the patient's exhaled end tidal carbon dioxide (ETCO2) level measured as a unit of pressure in millimeters of mercury (mmHg), percentage or, kilopascal (kPa).

eVitals.17.name: Carbon Monoxide (CO)
eVitals.17.definition: The numeric value of the patient's carbon monoxide level measured as a percentage (%) of carboxyhemoglobin (COHb).

eVitals.19.name: Glasgow Coma Score-Eye
eVitals.19.definition: The patient's Glasgow Coma Score Eye opening response.

eVitals.20.name: Glasgow Coma Score-Verbal
eVitals.20.definition: The patient's Glasgow Coma Score Verbal response.

eVitals.21.name: Glasgow Coma Score-Motor
eVitals.21.definition: The patient's Glasgow Coma Score Motor response.

eVitals.22.name: Glasgow Coma Score-Qualifier
eVitals.22.definition: Documentation of factors which make the GCS score more meaningful.

eVitals.23.name: Total Glasgow Coma Score
eVitals.23.definition: The patient's total Glasgow Coma Score.

eVitals.24.name: Temperature
eVitals.24.definition: The patient's body temperature in degrees Celsius/centigrade.

eVitals.25.name: Temperature Method
eVitals.25.definition: The method used to obtain the patient's body temperature.

eVitals.26.name: Level of Responsiveness (AVPU)
eVitals.26.definition: The patient's highest level of responsiveness.

eVitals.27.name: Pain Scale Score
eVitals.27.definition: The patient's indication of pain from a scale of 0-10.

eVitals.28.name: Pain Scale Type
eVitals.28.definition: The type of pain scale used.

eVitals.29.name: Stroke Scale Score
eVitals.29.definition: The findings or results of the Stroke Scale Type (eVitals.30) used to assess the patient exhibiting stroke-like symptoms.

eVitals.30.name: Stroke Scale Type
eVitals.30.definition: The type of stroke scale used.

eVitals.31.name: Reperfusion Checklist
eVitals.31.definition: The results of the patient's Reperfusion Checklist for potential Thrombolysis use.
